meta.title: female
meta.author: Agoston
meta.description: female by Agoston, a Farbrausch V2 song (.v2m format version 5) taken from modland's V2 collection (`pub/modules/V2/Agoston/female.v2m`). 120 BPM, 2:10, 14 tracks. This is an adapted version, not the original recording: converted by `synth-convert v2m` to the unified synth (instrument kind 64) and imported with `song import`. This song was not parity-checked on its own; the V2 import passes on the 18 songs that were (within 0.9 dB loudness and 1.8 dB per octave band of the v2redux reference). Agoston is the joint alias of Teo and Vincenzo; they gave permission (2026-11-09) to publish Agoston's music here as adapted versions; the music belongs to them and is removed at their request.
